📱 Share Map on Mobile

Upload blocked by the file host.

Free hosts now reject uploads sent from a file opened on disk. To get your link + QR, go back to QGIS, run Instant WebGIS Viewer → Export Map, then click “Create Share Link + QR” in the plugin. The link is baked into this file and this button will then show it here.
